description: Affected selection map (refactor proposal 001; scripts/affected_select.py). Each rule ties path globs to step groups of scripts/test-all.* and the CI jobs, plus .NET test projects that read the matched files at run time. Globs are matched case-insensitively against repository paths: '**' spans folders, '*' and '?' stay inside one folder, a glob without '/' matches the file name in any folder. Every changed file must match at least one rule, otherwise the run is full (fail safe). A rule with no groups marks files that no step reads (documentation, agent notes).

groups.dotnet: dotnet tool restore, build, format, test with the 90 % coverage gate (affected projects via dotnet-affected)
groups.dotnet-agent-floor: StemStudio.Agent coverage floor (only when StemStudio.Agent.Tests is affected)
groups.dotnet-agent-eval-floor: StemStudio.AgentEval coverage floor (only when StemStudio.AgentEval.Tests is affected)
groups.dotnet-perf: performance budgets, uninstrumented (only when StemStudio.Api.Tests is affected)
groups.worker: worker uv sync, ruff, mypy, pytest + coverage
groups.generator: generator uv sync, ruff, mypy, pytest + coverage
groups.audio-engine: audio engine npm ci, lint, typecheck, test:coverage, build
groups.soundtouch: SoundTouch WASM: emsdk pin check, Node WASM suite (test:wasm), reproducible build in CI
groups.web-interop: web-interop npm ci, lint, typecheck, test:coverage, build
groups.contracts: OpenAPI contract lint, superset and merge checks, output schema, vectors
groups.secret-scan: secret scan self-test and scan (tracked files)
groups.scripts-tests: devops check scripts (scripts/tests) ruff, mypy, pytest + coverage, split E2E jobs check
groups.compose: compose validation and the key volume check for every compose combination
groups.quality-gate: SIG checks on the whole code base (tools/quality/run_all.py)
groups.site: website npm ci, unit tests, build + check (tools/site)
groups.fixtures: fixture generator and backup fixture tools: ruff, mypy, pytest + coverage, generation
groups.e2e-lint: E2E suite npm ci, lint, typecheck, list
groups.cpu-image: CI only: CPU worker image guard and fonts
groups.generator-image: CI only: fake generator image guard
groups.licences: CI only: licence report (NuGet, Python, npm)
